title_zh: 核对面包配料后买一打并补齐零钱

scenario.label_zh: 在面包店核对配料与数量后付款
scenario.goal_zh: 核对面包配料与单价，确定数量并补齐零钱

context_zh: 顾客琼在一家虚构美国面包店的柜台购买面包卷。
author: author-phase07-b

sentences.speaker: June
sentences.text: Are these rolls made with any dairy ingredients? I'm buying them for someone who avoids milk.

sentences.speaker: Marco
sentences.text: The plain ones aren't, according to our ingredient sheet. Would you like to read it here at the counter?

sentences.speaker: June
sentences.text: Yes, thanks. This looks suitable. How much are the plain rolls?

sentences.speaker: Marco
sentences.text: Fifty cents each, or six dollars for twelve.

sentences.speaker: June
sentences.text: I'll take a dozen, please. Here's five dollars and ninety cents.

sentences.speaker: June
sentences.text: I've got a dime in this pocket. Here you go.

sentences.speaker: Marco
sentences.text: Thank you. That's six dollars exactly, and your twelve rolls are in this bag.

targets.sense_zh: 美国或加拿大的十分硬币
